import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a bar chart to compare survival rates by gender
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rates by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a histogram to show the distribution of ages
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(df['age'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Ages')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between fare and survival
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='fare', y='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Relationship between Fare and Survival')
plt.xlabel('Fare')
plt.ylabel('Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
